scenario.name: Break Escape SAFETYNET: Mission 7 — The Architect's Gambit
scenario.author: Z. Cliffe Schreuders
scenario.description: Virtual machines for the Break Escape SAFETYNET mission 7 narrative experience. The target (scada_attack_host) is leaking pieces of a login through two separate misconfigured services: an over-shared network file share reveals part of the puzzle, and an unusual open port hands out the rest to anyone who connects. Piece together the recovered credentials, log in as a regular user, and collect a flag from their home directory. From there, a permissive sudo rule lets an ordinary command break out into a root shell - work out which allowed command can be abused to complete the takeover.

CyBOK.keyword: Vulnerabilities and attacks on access control misconfigurations

SAFETYNET -- FIELD DEPLOYMENT (eyes only, wiped on exfil) Op: ARCHITECT'S GAMBIT Handler: HaX (agent_0x99) Agent: 0x00 ================================================================
Agent -- this box is your kit for the night. It sits on the facility maintenance VLAN, the one the SCADA contractor left wide open. Everything you need is in reach from here, and nothing on it leaves the segment.
THE TARGET Pacific Northwest Regional Grid Control, Portland. 147 substations, 8.4 million people on the other end of it. The host that matters is the operator's backup / staging box -- asset tag reads 172.16.0.2, same maintenance VLAN as you. That is the one you work.
THE WAY IN Don't force it. The operator's login is leaking across the box's own services -- the handoff share gives you half, an open relay port hands out the rest. Map the host first, then read what each service tells you. Put the two pieces together and you have his account.
ONE STRING, MORE THAN ONE DOOR The man who runs this stack is vain and lazy in the same breath. He won't set a thing twice. A code you recover here may open more than the login it was meant for -- carry it, don't retype it.
THE CLOCK The sequence is local and hardcoded. It starts the moment your login goes through the relay: fifteen minutes, no pause, no abort from outside. The one place the abort goes in is the control room console, north of the server hall. So the order is in, up to root, then the console.
Call me the second you hit something you can't open. -- HaX

RELAY NOTES -- agent scratch ============================ HaX keeps a tap on the control VLAN -- the relay that has sat on their segment since the recon pass. Whatever the operator's services say in clear, it catches.
- The maintenance export is world-mountable. "Migration window," they told the auditor. It is not. The operator handoff file is sitting in it. - A service up on a high port answers anyone and reads back a credential line. That is the relay's catch -- it forwards whatever the box leaks. - The clock starts on the login, not on the scan. Map the host all you want; the fifteen minutes do not move until the account actually goes through.
Elena, the engineer in the server hall, has the control room door code. If she turns she will give it. If she does not, keep working the box -- it hands you what you need either way.

PNRGC CONTROL ROOM -- SHIFT HANDOVER Operator: J. Mercer (OptiGrid Solutions, SCADA stack) Shift: nights --------------------------------------------------------------- - Rebalancing left on AUTO. Do NOT touch; the sequence job drives the breakers. - Step 02 (PORTLAND) holds until the host kicks it. Hold means hold. - Backup genset online, 72h rating. Elena keeps asking for the load-shed tables; read-only, do not send. - Vault keypad was reset 16 JUN after the cabling survey. Ask T. Park if you need it. - Anyone asks why the maintenance share is open: "migration window". It is not.

SCADA STACK -- MAINTENANCE NOTES (OptiGrid Solutions) Site: Pacific Northwest Regional Grid Control (147 substations, 8.4M served, WA/OR/N.CAL) Host role: backup / staging for the cascade control system. Mirrors the live sequence loader. Standing instruction from the client: keep the loaded sequence resident across reboots. This account can sudo awk without a password -- "so the night operator can grep the logs fast". Change control: waived by the client. The client signs as "A."

CASCADE CONTROL SYSTEM -- SEQUENCE AUTHORITY (ROOT) ================================================================ SCHEDULE / ONE AUTHORITY / ALL CELLS -- WINDOW OPENS 02:40 PT
01 SEATTLE METRO open critical breakers ARMED 02 PORTLAND absorb shed load HOLD -- START ON HOST 03 OREGON safety shutdown, sequential PENDING 04 NORTHERN CAL load imbalance trip PENDING
CELL: Critical Mass (Operation BLACKOUT) SITE: PORTLAND / PNRGC The sequence starts only from a host inside the building. This is that host. Abort is physical: pull the originating host off the control VLAN.
"Entropy is inevitable. Systems decay. I merely publish the schedule." -- A.
